description:
• Earn a 10% commission on all sales that come from your affiliate link. Also receive a custom 10% off discount code you can share to improve your affiliate success.
  • At CoolerDog, our passion is designing and making cooling products that work really well, are comfortable for dogs, while being convenient and affordable for you. As cooling professionals, we understand that the three best methods of protecting a dog from the heat are; Physical Cooling, Hydration and Shade.
  • We use water instead of any other material because it is efficient, safe, clean, green, and inexpensive. We don’t use chemicals, animal fats, or oils (vegetable or petroleum based) because they are less efficient at absorbing heat than the alternative.
  • Payment terms: Quarterly Payout
term_and_condition:
1. Overview: By participating in the CoolerDog Affiliate Program, you agree to comply with the terms and conditions outlined below. CoolerDog reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the program at any time.

  2. Eligibility: To be eligible for the CoolerDog Affiliate Program, you must be at least 18 years old and have a valid website or social media presence. CoolerDog reserves the right to reject any application for any reason.

  3. Application Process: Submit an application through the CoolerDog Affiliate Program portal. We will review your application and notify you of your acceptance status. CoolerDog reserves the right to accept or reject applications at its discretion.

  4. Commissions: Affiliates will earn a commission on qualifying sales generated through their unique affiliate link. The commission rate will be determined by CoolerDog and is subject to change. Commissions are paid monthly, and payments will be made through the selected payment method in the affiliate portal.

  5. Affiliate Responsibilities:

    • Affiliates must accurately represent CoolerDog products and brand.
    • Affiliates are responsible for the content on their websites and social media channels.
    • Affiliates may not engage in any form of deceptive advertising or use unethical marketing practices.

  6. Prohibited Activities:

    • Affiliates may not bid on CoolerDog brand terms or use brand terms in a way that may mislead or confuse customers.
    • Affiliates may not engage in spammy or fraudulent activities.
    • Affiliates may not create websites or content that violates intellectual property rights or promotes illegal activities.

  7. Termination: CoolerDog reserves the right to terminate an affiliate's participation in the program at any time for any reason. Termination may result from violations of these terms and conditions.

  8. Intellectual Property: Affiliates are granted a limited, non-exclusive, and revocable license to use CoolerDog logos, trademarks, and marketing materials solely for the purpose of promoting CoolerDog products.

  9. Confidentiality: Affiliates agree to keep all confidential information received from CoolerDog confidential and not disclose it to any third party.

  10. Modifications: CoolerDog may modify these terms and conditions at any time. Affiliates will be notified of changes, and continued participation implies acceptance of the modified terms.

  11. Governing Law: These terms and conditions are governed by the laws of the state of Wisconsin, USA.

By participating in the CoolerDog Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to abide by these terms and conditions.
